checks.name: build_and_incremental_contract
checks.result: Workspace/examples compiled; three focused indexer checks passed. The source lifecycle example also passed after storage changes, including rollback, conflict rejection and unavailable recovery.

checks.name: content_config_and_idempotence
checks.result: An unchanged five-source fixture caused no project revision change. One work edit indexed one source; unchanged W1 retained its entity revision and ID while provenance refreshed. Rule options changed hard/project semantics without a file fingerprint change. Warnings survived skipped runs.

checks.name: deletion_and_unavailability
checks.result: A removed ADR and deleted work/evidence became inactive; identity rows and a runtime event linked to the removed work survived. An unavailable directory caused no retirement and retained diagnostic rows, then recovered after restoration.

checks.name: rebuild_boundary
checks.result: Deleting the fixture database and indexing again reconstructed the same work keys, statuses, acceptance and next action. The original user.marker runtime event did not reappear. Doctor integrity passed; canonical source aliases were rejected.

checks.name: project_self_index
checks.result: The complete own-project mapping indexed seven files in one run (ledger, goals, plan, rules, three ADRs). A second run skipped all seven with project revision unchanged at 21 and all 12 unresolved-rule warnings retained.

limitations: Functional source intake on this project is verified locally. Runtime self-hosting, task/context commands and real-client business acceptance remain pending; unannotated rule severity/scope are still unresolved. Full regression and optimization remain later milestones.
